summary: Feed s170_triple is degraded: 3 faults confirmed. 100% of packets are untagged (VLANs 10,20 missing), microbursts hit 2.77 Gbps on a 1 Gbps IDS port (277% overload), and 65.5% of bytes are encrypted exceeding the IDS 60% tolerance.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker egress (or SPAN) is stripping 802.1Q tags - 100% of packets arrived untagged despite IDS requiring VLANs 10 and 20, indicating 'vlan strip' enabled on broker output or SPAN trunk not forwarding tags.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot segment, filter or correlate by VLAN 10/20; blind to VLAN-hopping, lateral movement and policy violations tied to those segments, reducing detection coverage for those zones to zero.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q headers through the broker to the IDS so it can see and enforce policies on VLANs 10 and 20.

findings.root_cause: Bursty aggregated traffic peaks at 2.77 Gbps in 1ms intervals vs 1 Gbps IDS port (277% of capacity, 4 overloaded intervals). Single 1G egress with no load-balancing or shaping cannot absorb microbursts.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS ingress buffers overrun and silently drop packets during bursts; IDS misses attacks that coincide with bursts and loses state for flow reassembly despite needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 3x1G IDS cluster (or upgrade to 10G) with 5-tuple hashing to keep per-port utilization <80% and preserve flow integrity for IDS stateful inspection.

findings.root_cause: 65.5% of bytes are encrypted vs 60% IDS tolerance, indicating growth in TLS traffic forwarded without selective decryption or filtering at the packet broker.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full payload inspection but cannot inspect encrypted payloads; detection degrades to metadata only for majority of traffic, missing exploits and C2 in encrypted flows.

params.method: passive TLS decryption with key escrow on packet broker
params.policy: selectively decrypt VLANs 10,20 / required protocols only

recommended_fix.why: Offload decryption before the IDS to restore payload visibility while respecting privacy and IDS full-payload requirement; do not use slicing or filtering which would further blind the IDS.
